author: ojiudezue
title: v5.108.1 shipped: Frigate MQTT direct ingress + face bridge on the runtime prefix
summary: Frigate MQTT direct ingress + face bridge on the runtime prefix
why: URA depended on a house-specific HA automation to bridge Frigate MQTT events onto the HA bus, which will not exist on another install. Portability is imperative. The face bridge listened on the retired 'frigate/' prefix (retained messages only), so Frigate 2 face names never reached URA. URA now subscribes to each Frigate entry's runtime topic prefix directly, with first-source dedup against the bus, and a latch-derived face leg can no longer demote a door alert without a non-face arrival.
implications: Shipped PERIMETER-FRIGATE-MQTT-DIRECT-1, FRIGATE-FACE-BRIDGE-DEAD-PREFIX-1 at v5.108.1; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.108.1.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Live: confirm the subscribe log line, ingress counters and face messages on frigate2; if a misrecognised face name shows up in alert text, revisit carrying Frigate's score on the synthetic leg
